prompt: Locate the service that owns Code Map process lifetime. Explain when the host starts and stops, with file and symbol citations.
acceptance: Identify CodeMapService, sync, opt-in and zero-enabled-project stop; cite current source and do not edit.
checks: npx vitest run --project unit-node src/main/services/code-map/code-map-service.test.ts

prompt: Explain how the @lib alias and @fixture/math package used by run resolve to source files. Give the intermediate re-export path.
acceptance: Resolve compute to calculate through index.ts and math.twice to the workspace source; cite configuration.
checks: Compare against expected.json imports and calls; all named paths must exist.

prompt: Describe the C# solution's project dependency direction and locate the app entry point. Do not run MSBuild or restore packages.
acceptance: Identify App to Core and Core.Tests to Core references and top-level Program.cs; no toolchain execution.
checks: Compare project references in csproj files and solution membership by source review.

prompt: Trace how a visualizer query reaches graphSlice and how node, edge and serialized-byte caps are enforced.
acceptance: Include plugin facade, main service and host boundaries; distinguish visits from response caps.
checks: npx vitest run --project unit-node src/code-map-host/query/slice.test.ts

prompt: Find the implementation and callers of emptyCodeMapCoverage. Report its initial file counters without editing anything.
acceptance: All initial counters are zero; cite definition and at least two real callers. Ordinary text search is sufficient.
checks: npx vitest run --project unit-node src/shared/domain/code-map.test.ts

prompt: Is shadow's compute call necessarily a call to calculate? Explain the lexical binding and why name matching alone would be wrong.
acceptance: Identify parameter shadowing; refuse the false calculate dependency and cite both declarations.
checks: Compare shadowedCaller and its note in expected.json; inspect the compute parameter.

prompt: Trace a latest map query issued immediately after a saved edit. Explain the timeout and how it differs from an empty result.
acceptance: Explain metadata reconciliation, 2 second barrier, INDEX_UPDATING and independent cancellation; do not promise full semantic coverage.
checks: npx vitest run --project unit-node src/code-map-host/query/freshness.test.ts

prompt: Trace Open in editor from the visualizer through validation to editor routing. Explain the checks that prevent opening a stale symbol span.
acceptance: Identify generation, hash, containment, symbol span and worktree identity checks, and column conversion to editor coordinates.
checks: npx vitest run --project integration tests/integration/code-map-plugin.test.ts

prompt: Rename calculate to increment in its implementation while keeping the public compute alias compatible. Update direct internal calls, and explain external callers that remain unchanged.
acceptance: No calculate identifier remains in math.ts or index.ts; increment returns value+1; compute alias and run output stay compatible; main.ts need not change.
checks: Review exported increment, Calculator.run and index.ts alias; execute run({value:2}) and require result 7 using a sandboxed external evaluator.

prompt: Add a defaulted factor argument to twice so twice(value, factor=2) multiplies by factor. Keep existing callers compatible and identify them.
acceptance: twice(3) is 6, twice(3,4) is 12 and run({value:2}) remains 7; public function stays exported.
checks: Evaluate twice(3), twice(3,4) and run({value:2}) in the fixed fixture runner; review all indexed and text-search callers.

prompt: Locate Order validation and explain how a negative ID is rejected, including calls through the partial class. Identify the tests to extend for zero and negative IDs.
acceptance: Describe the actual validation expression and Process/Validate flow from source; identify zero and negative boundary expectations without inventing framework behavior.
checks: Review partial declarations and existing ValidatesPositiveIds test; compare expected.json calls.

prompt: Trace both Save calls from Program.cs, distinguish overloads by argument count, and follow Save to Validate and Process.
acceptance: Cite both Save declarations and receiver type; describe exact nested calls and do not claim dynamic dispatch completeness.
checks: Compare all matching Program.cs and OrderRepository.cs calls with expected.json.

prompt: Explain OrderRepository's base class and interface, including where inherited Log resolves and why framework calls may be absent from the map.
acceptance: Identify extends RepositoryBase, implements IRepository and Log to Write; distinguish external unresolved calls.
checks: Compare expected.json inheritance and calls; cite declared base and interface source.

prompt: Find the exact setting label Keep .oxy out of Git and explain its default value. Cite the UI and schema definitions.
acceptance: Default is true; locate the real renderer label using text search; do not infer behavior from the label alone.
checks: npx vitest run --project unit-node src/shared/domain/code-map.test.ts

prompt: Find the exported run function in src/main.ts and give its declared parameter and return types. Do not change code.
acceptance: Report options: Options and number; cite the declaration. No graph traversal is needed.
checks: Inspect the exported run declaration in src/main.ts.

prompt: Trace Code Map invalidation events into the visualizer. Explain where event subscriptions create runtime links that cannot be proven by a static call graph.
acceptance: Cite registration, dispatch and listener; identify updating/indexing suppression and deduplication; do not describe all runtime subscribers as known.
checks: npx vitest run --project unit-node plugins/code-map-visualizer/src/host/index.test.ts src/plugin-host/api.test.ts

prompt: Investigate order.IsNew in Program.cs. Find the source implementation and explain why missing static call edges do not prove it is unused.
acceptance: Locate the extension method using ordinary source search when necessary; explicitly acknowledge member-not-found-or-extension-method and preprocessor uncertainty.
checks: Compare unresolvedCalls and heuristic Describe entries in expected.json with current source.

prompt: Determine what Code Map currently knows about Python files and whether a Python call graph is available. Locate the support-level implementation and explain the fallback.
acceptance: At this pinned stage Python is file-only; do not claim symbols or calls from the existence of a bundled grammar. Recommend text search and source reading.
checks: Review actual extractor dispatch and language support table at the pinned revision.

prompt: Compare the imported compute call in run with the parameter call in shadow. Identify which can resolve statically and list the evidence for each conclusion.
acceptance: Only imported compute binds to calculate; parameter compute remains unknown; report the re-export alias and lexical scope.
checks: Compare expected.json calls and shadowedCaller; verify no global name-based false match.

prompt: Trace preparation and removal of an Ensemble worktree's map. Explain how a pending registration is revoked if the worktree is removed.
acceptance: Identify ready/remove hooks, worktreeRequests token, isolated checkout ID and main/project root authorization; explain best-effort map failure handling.
checks: npx vitest run --project unit-node src/main/services/code-map/code-map-service.test.ts src/main/services/ensemble/ensemble-service.test.ts

prompt: Explain why Changes in a task checkout still includes a committed task edit. Trace authorization and comparison against the stored base, including projects in repository subfolders.
acceptance: Use registered checkout and task identity; compare baseCommit to working tree; describe --relative and refuse arbitrary root/base supplied by a plugin.
checks: npx vitest run --project unit-node src/main/services/code-map/checkout-changes.test.ts
npx vitest run --project integration tests/integration/code-map-worktrees.test.ts

prompt: Audit whether Impact can follow heuristic or membership edges by default and whether a cycle can run forever. Explain the actual filters and hard limits.
acceptance: Identify default heuristic exclusion, contains exclusion, visited-node/edge sets, depth 1-3 and caps 2000/5000; missing edges remain non-exhaustive.
checks: npx vitest run --project unit-node src/code-map-host/query/slice.test.ts

prompt: Investigate whether hiding the visualizer can cancel another agent's indexing. Trace reader cancellation and state what is shared versus per request.
acceptance: Cancellation stops the reader wait; shared reconciliation continues; identify AbortController and query request identity without claiming the shared build is aborted.
checks: npx vitest run --project unit-node src/code-map-host/query/freshness.test.ts plugins/code-map-visualizer/src/host/index.test.ts

prompt: A developer sees Java and Go WASM grammars in the installation and assumes Calls support. Verify that claim at this revision and explain where language coverage is reported.
acceptance: Distinguish bundled grammar from implemented extractor/resolver; both are file-only at stage 10; cite actual support reporting and fallback.
checks: Review grammar manifest, extractor dispatch and shared language support data at the pinned revision.

prompt: Audit the permission checks for getCheckoutChanges in both plugin API layers. Explain what happens if a plugin loses permission while Git is running.
acceptance: Identify git.read plus code-map.read on both boundaries, post-await revocation checks and strict project/checkout identity validation; do not claim Node plugins are sandboxed.
checks: npx vitest run --project unit-node src/plugin-host/api.test.ts src/main/services/plugins/plugin-host-service.test.ts

prompt: Find every partial declaration of Order and identify the source edits and callers needed to rename Validate to ValidateOrder, without changing behavior.
acceptance: List every declaration and textual call site from the pinned sources; distinguish Process from Validate, include tests and report any unresolved callers rather than claiming exhaustiveness.
checks: Search all .cs files for Validate and compare the call entries in expected.json; source review verifies the proposed rename touches all matches.
